stock.description: China Vered Financial Holding Corporation Limited operates as an investment holding entity, providing a diverse array of financial services. These offerings span asset management, consultancy, financing solutions, and securities advisory and brokerage. Additionally, the company is involved in insurance agency and money lending activities. Established in 1972, this Hong Kong-based firm, headquartered in Causeway Bay, was previously known as China Minsheng Financial Holding Corporation Limited before adopting its current name in July 2020.
